requirements.title: Instruction-Edit Model Class
requirements.description: An instruction-edit op + model class (Flux-Kontext / Qwen-Image-Edit-style) for identity-preserving, prompt-only semantic edits ('make him older', 'change the jacket'), distinct from img2img (global + strength knob) and inpaint (masked region). Runs locally on a capable GPU; BYOK-cloud is the CPU/low-VRAM path with hardware-fit + cost surfaced up front. Seeded models must be commercial-clean per the existing license gate.

validation.notes: buildDiffusers dispatches edit_instruct to the instruction-edit sidecar module (distinct argv from inpaint), threads the instruction + guidance, and rejects a missing input — TestArgBuilders cases 'diffusers edit_instruct', 'diffusers inpaint via dispatcher'.
Full edit_instruct vertical over fake providers: materializes the single input, threads the natural-language instruction, persists output — TestGeneration_EditInstructMaterializesInput.

Instruction-edit models (instruct-pix2pix default CPU-capable, qwen-image-edit GPU quality) seeded with hardware-fit + commercial-clean licenses; flux-1-kontext-dev blocklisted — seed-invariant validation in Load().
CLI `image-tools ai edit <input> --prompt` submits the async instruction-edit job — TestEditInstruct_SubmitsAsyncJob; TestSubmitCommandsCoverP0 pins the verb set.
